title: Chris Bledsoe's message from the lady

tellings.quote: >> This is the message. She told me that she had many names throughout history and that God is God and we don't know what we think we know and we need to sit back and reanalyze and, you know, be good children and we're going off the cliff.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe says a female figure he calls "the lady" gave him a message: she has had "many names throughout history", "God is God", and "we don't know what we think we know." He tells Michels she urged people to step back, rethink, and "be good children", because "we're going off the cliff." Bledsoe tells it as his own experience, and if true it would be a warning to humanity from a being who claims to have been known under many names across history.
